CropSpecIn.description:
Mirrors `vm.CropSpec`. `rect` is in **model-frame coordinates** — the
taught model's own reference-image frame, i.e. the same coordinates as
`ModelOut.roi` — so a sensible default is the taught model's own `roi`.

normalize_scale.description: Render at model scale (True, canonical) or found scale (False).
normalize_scale.title: Normalize Scale

CropSpecIn.title: CropSpecIn

DisplacementRequest.description:
Ordered sequence of at least 2 images; `window` (level-0 pixel coordinates,
in the *first* image) is tracked pairwise through the sequence. Mirrors
`vision_metrology::corr::DisplacementConfig`.
DisplacementRequest.title: DisplacementRequest

MeasureConfigIn.description: Overrides for `vm.MeasureConfig`; unset fields fall back to library defaults.
MeasureConfigIn.title: MeasureConfigIn

MeasureObjectIn.description:
One metrology object, nominal geometry given in **model frame** (the taught
`ShapeModel`'s own coordinates, i.e. relative to its `origin`).
MeasureObjectIn.title: MeasureObjectIn

calibration_id.description: When set, the response is augmented with millimetre values (pixel_to_plane over the calibration's camera_index camera and plane).
calibration_id.title: Calibration Id

camera_index.description: Index into the calibration's camera list.
camera_index.title: Camera Index

coverage_fraction.description: fraction of the grid this camera's mask covers
coverage_fraction.title: Coverage Fraction

camera_index.description: Index into the calibration's camera list.
camera_index.title: Camera Index

MosaicGridIn.description:
Explicit grid spec over the calibration's `z = 0` plane; any field left unset is
auto-fit from the requested cameras' own image-border footprints on that plane
(`pixel_to_plane` on a border sample, unioned, plus a small margin).
MosaicGridIn.title: MosaicGridIn

cameras.description: At least 2 cameras -- a mosaic of 1 is just a crop.
cameras.title: Cameras

overlap_fraction.description: fraction of the *union* covered by >= 2 cameras
overlap_fraction.title: Overlap Fraction

seam_disparity_p50.description: null when no pixel is jointly covered by >= 2 cameras
seam_disparity_p50.title: Seam Disparity P50

OverlayPrimitiveOut.description:
Mirrors `@vitavision/lab-ui`'s `MeasurePrimitive` union exactly (field names and
units — angles in radians) so the frontend can pass this straight through.
OverlayPrimitiveOut.title: OverlayPrimitiveOut

PlaneIn.description:
A plane in the calibration's reference frame: `n . X + d = 0`. Defaults to the
rig/table frame's own `z = 0` plane — the common case (a flat stage/conveyor).
PlaneIn.title: PlaneIn

validity.description: fraction of crop pixels sampled from inside the scene
validity.title: Validity
